g.text: Terms: ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of

Defense · EHA = environmental hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 210) · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · HHA = health hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 207) ·

MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PHA = preliminary hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 202) · PHL = preliminary hazard list (MIL-STD-882E Task 201) · PX4 = PX4

Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SHA = system hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 205) · SRHA = system requirements

hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 203) · SSHA = subsystem hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 204) · SSPP = system safety program plan (MIL-STD-882E Task 102) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · UAV = uncrewed aerial
